notes.title: We're coming to Baltic Dev Days!
notes.content:

Laufen und Raufen playable at Baltic Dev Days! 

We're happy to announce that Laufen und Raufen will be playable at the Nurogames booth at the Baltic Dev Days 2019 in Kiel.
For more information and tickets head to www.balticdevdays.com
